authority: Causal record of the incomplete first diagnostic and one prospective P40000-only continuation; no performance selection, runtime change, numerical waiver or production authority.

instrumented_observations.authority: Profiler-affected diagnostics only. Engine timers and external elapsed intervals have different instrumentation exposure; none replaces unprofiled v127 performance or selects a gain.

partial_result.attribution_status: Retain the completed short capture for offline attribution; no P65 repetition is authorized.

stop.boundary: Ownership audit before P40000 request, after the complete P65 response and witness.
stop.driver_rule: Only descendants of the launched profiler root were allowed. An NSys agent reparented to PID 1 was outside that descendant set.
stop.causal_assessment: The recorded agent names the exact launched profile-533610 session and NSys executable, explaining the tree-only ownership false positive. This is a specific session-identity finding, not evidence of actual foreign GPU contention or permission to allow arbitrary NSys processes. The original audit and its stopped outcome remain unchanged.
stop.claim_limit: The original snapshot did not bind boot ID, executable inode, PID start time and namespace as the successor will. Do not retroactively claim those stronger identity checks were performed.

cleanup.interpretation: The first two-request diagnostic is incomplete; normal profiler exit and empty final GPU ownership are preserved as separate cleanup facts.

successor.identity: Use the unchanged exact installed cap 3 binary, model, profile and P40000 request from the parent design. Record the final successor driver hash before launch; no rebuild, route or policy change.
successor.capture: One fresh ordinary API server under node-level NSys tracing, capturing q3x.generation for P40000/O256 only; stop capture after that range and retain complete request, response and route witness.
exact_profiler_process_binding: Before launch, require complete process/GPU audit and no GPU holders; preserve the parent diagnostic contention, temperature and cache-preparation policy.

Bind the launched profiler root by PID plus start-time ticks, boot ID, UID, PID namespace, resolved executable, executable device/inode and recorded executable hash. Revalidate live root identity at each owned audit.

Allow the verified root descendant tree. Additionally identify an orphan agent only when its exact argv is the bound NSys executable, --start-agent, --session-name profile-<this root PID>, --shm-name with the NSys UUID, this PID namespace ID and the pinned 2026.1.3 version.

Require the agent resolved executable and device/inode, UID and PID namespace to match the binding, and its start time not to predate the bound root. Retain each matching agent PID, PPID, start time, argv and binding.
Any unmatched GPU holder, incomplete ownership audit or changed root identity stops the attempt. No comm-name, generic session-prefix or repository-path whitelist is authorized.
After owned shutdown, audit with no allowed processes and require complete GPU/process inspection with zero remaining GPU holders.
successor.oracle: Full output text, generated token IDs, usage, finish/DONE, route identity and every non-timing work field must match the existing same-cap installed P40000 baseline. Preserve any mismatch without retry.
successor.context_limit: The missing long capture now comes from a fresh process rather than following P65 in the same process. Record this change explicitly; do not treat the two captures as a repeated or matched unprofiled performance comparison.
successor.completion: After this one continuation and offline analysis of the retained short and long captures, close profiling. The next action remains a named equivalence-ledger executor composition with bounded API return, or explicit rejection of a materially unsupported mechanism.
successor.failure: A failure remains part of the record and does not authorize another automatic attempt or repetition of P65. Any further continuation requires a new causal record and bounded decision.
successor.environment: Inherit the parent diagnostic thresholds and ownership/safety gates unchanged. Failed cache drop only removes a cold-cache claim; temperature above 85C through 90C is context, above 90C stops. No fan inspection/control.
